hrm.att.explain.absent_no_punch: Absent: no punch on a working day (shift {start} to {end}).
hrm.att.explain.absent_worked: Absent: worked {worked} minutes, less than the {limit} minutes below which a day is an absence.
hrm.att.explain.half_day_early: Half day: left {early} minutes early (shift ends {end}, last punch {lastOut}); {limit} minutes or more makes a half day.
hrm.att.explain.half_day_late: Half day: late {late} minutes (shift starts {start}, first punch {firstIn}); {limit} minutes or more makes a half day.
hrm.att.explain.half_day_worked: Half day: worked {worked} minutes, less than the {limit} minutes of a full day.
hrm.att.explain.incomplete_missing_in: Incomplete: only one punch, an out punch at {at}; the in punch is missing.
hrm.att.explain.incomplete_missing_out: Incomplete: only one punch, at {at}; the out punch is missing.
hrm.att.explain.incomplete_unscheduled: Incomplete: {count} punches on a day with no published shift; ask HR to publish the roster.
hrm.att.explain.late: Late {late} minutes: shift starts {start}, first punch {firstIn}, grace {grace}.
hrm.att.explain.on_duty: On duty: an approved request ({kind}) covers the day.
hrm.att.explain.on_leave: On leave: approved leave covers the day.
hrm.att.explain.present: Present: first punch {firstIn}, last punch {lastOut}, worked {worked} minutes.
hrm.att.explain.present_left_early: Present, left {early} minutes early: shift ends {end}, last punch {lastOut}, grace {grace}.
hrm.att.skip.locked: The day is in a locked attendance period and is not processed again.
hrm.att.skip.no_pay_period: The employee has no pay group or no pay period covers the day, so the result cannot be stored; ask payroll.
hrm.att.skip.no_policy: No attendance policy applies; ask HR.
hrm.att.skip.no_roster: No shift is published for this day and there are no punches.
hrm.att.skip.not_employed: The employment does not cover this day.
hrm.att.skip.not_finished: The day is not over yet (its shift and window have not ended); it is worked out after that.
hrm.att.skip.policy_invalid: The attendance policy in force cannot be read; ask HR to correct it.
hrm.att.step.break_fixed: A fixed break of {minutes} minutes taken off.
hrm.att.step.break_punches: {minutes} minutes between middle punches taken off as breaks.
hrm.att.step.duty_part: An approved {kind} from {from} to {to} counts as time at work.
hrm.att.step.early: Left {early} minutes early: shift ends {end}, last punch {lastOut}, grace {grace}.
hrm.att.step.early_within_grace: Last punch {early} minutes before the end, within the grace of {grace} minutes.
hrm.att.step.full_day: A full day needs {minutes} minutes (from the {source}); fewer than {absentBelow} minutes is an absence.
hrm.att.step.hour_leave: Approved hourly leave of {minutes} minutes on this day reduces the minutes needed.
hrm.att.step.not_counted: {count} punches not counted: repeated or corrected.
hrm.att.step.odd_count: An odd number of punches ({count}): one punch has no partner.
hrm.att.step.outside_window: {count} punches more than {window} minutes before the shift starts or after it ends were not counted.
hrm.att.step.part_leave: Approved leave of {quantity} day ({part}) on this day: its half is not checked for lateness or early leaving and the minutes needed are reduced.
hrm.att.step.punches_ignored: {count} punches on this day are not counted.
hrm.att.step.rest_work_ignored: {count} punches on this day are not counted, as the policy says.
hrm.att.step.rest_work_recorded: {worked} minutes worked on this day are recorded.
hrm.att.step.roster_day: The published roster makes the day {dayType}.
hrm.att.step.rounded: Worked minutes rounded ({mode}, steps of {step}) from {from} to {to}.
hrm.att.step.weekly_off_pattern: No roster line; the shift policy's weekly-off pattern makes the day a weekly off.
hrm.att.step.holiday_calendar: No roster line and not a weekly off; the day is a holiday of the employee's holiday calendar.
hrm.att.step.season: The season {season} of the policy {policy} sets the shift's times on this day.
hrm.att.step.within_grace: First punch {late} minutes after the start, within the grace of {grace} minutes.
